name: mallok
description: Open-source, Cloudflare-native content website. Markdown in D1, instant publishing, no build step.
author: JasonYv

scripts.build: pnpm run build:themes && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:cli && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:themes && pnpm run build:admin && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && node scripts/ensure-secret.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build:site: pnpm run build:cli && node dist/cli/index.js build . --theme ./src/themes/atelier --out dist/site

MALLOK_SECRET.description: Required. Signs sessions and encrypts plugin API keys. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it — changing it signs everyone out and makes stored plugin keys unreadable.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. A Cloudflare API token with **Zone → Cache Purge → Purge**, scoped to this site’s zone. Without it the site works, but an edit becomes visible when the cached page expires rather than immediately.

CF_ZONE_ID.description: Optional, and only useful together with `CF_API_TOKEN`. The Zone ID shown on your domain’s overview page in the Cloudflare dashboard.
